```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =====================================================================
# Cluster(region)-level intra vs inter ASV sharing (Jaccard similarity).
#
# R Markdown version
# - Original style retained
# - Reads exported QIIME2 feature-table.tsv directly
# - No qiime2R required
# - No biom command required
# - Saves both PDF and SVG
#
# EXPLORATORY / comparison only -- NOT a paper-ready result.
#   - intra(r) = within-region sample-pair Jaccard sharing
#   - inter(r) = region r vs other regions sample-pair sharing
#   - Wilcoxon BH + label-permutation p
#
# CAVEATS:
#   (1) 3 distant cities differ for many reasons
#       diet/batch/recruitment -> intra>inter is near-automatic & confounded
#   (2) no village sub-unit -> sample-pairwise pseudoreplication inflates n
# =====================================================================

required_pkgs <- c("vegan", "svglite")

for (pkg in required_pkgs) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
  }
}

suppressMessages(library(vegan))
```

# 1. User parameters

```{r parameters}
## ------------------------- USER PARAMETERS ---------------------------
asv_table_path <- "inputs/exported_clustering_table/feature-table.tsv"
metadata_path  <- "inputs/clustering_meta.txt"

sample_id_col  <- NA
region_col     <- "category"

table_features_as_rows <- TRUE

do_rarefy      <- TRUE
min_depth      <- NA

detect_thr     <- 0.001       # 0.1% relative abundance
max_per_region <- 300         # subsample cap per region
n_perm         <- 200         # label permutations

seed           <- 1
out_dir        <- "results"
## --------------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(seed)
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

# 2. Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
read_tsv_table <- function(path, far = TRUE) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop("Feature table not found: ", path)
  }

  first <- readLines(path, n = 1)

  skip <- if (grepl("^# Constructed", first)) {
    1L
  } else {
    0L
  }

  df <- read.table(
    path,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t",
    quote = "",
    comment.char = "",
    check.names = FALSE,
    skip = skip,
    row.names = 1,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  m <- as.matrix(df)
  storage.mode(m) <- "numeric"

  if (!far) {
    m <- t(m)
  }

  m
}

read_metadata <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop("Metadata file not found: ", path)
  }

  lines <- readLines(path)

  lines <- lines[!grepl("^#q2:types", lines)]

  con <- textConnection(lines)
  on.exit(close(con))

  read.table(
    con,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t",
    quote = "",
    comment.char = "",
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

pair_vals <- function(M, inR, outR, which) {
  if (which == "intra") {
    sub <- M[inR, inR, drop = FALSE]
    sub[upper.tri(sub)]
  } else {
    c(M[inR, outR])
  }
}

stars <- function(p) {
  ifelse(
    p < 1e-4, "****",
    ifelse(
      p < 1e-3, "***",
      ifelse(
        p < 1e-2, "**",
        ifelse(p < 0.05, "*", "ns")
      )
    )
  )
}

violin_at <- function(v, xc, width, col) {
  v <- v[is.finite(v)]

  if (length(v) < 5) {
    return(invisible())
  }

  d <- density(v)
  w <- d$y / max(d$y) * width

  polygon(
    c(xc - w, rev(xc + w)),
    c(d$x, rev(d$x)),
    col = col,
    border = "grey30",
    lwd = 0.7
  )

  qs <- quantile(v, c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)

  rect(
    xc - 0.02,
    qs[1],
    xc + 0.02,
    qs[3],
    col = "white",
    border = "grey30",
    lwd = 0.7
  )

  segments(
    xc - 0.035,
    qs[2],
    xc + 0.035,
    qs[2],
    lwd = 1.3
  )
}
```

# 3. Load table and metadata

```{r load-data}
feat <- read_tsv_table(
  asv_table_path,
  far = table_features_as_rows
)

meta <- read_metadata(metadata_path)

dim(feat)
head(meta)
```

# 4. Match sample IDs

```{r match-samples}
if (is.na(sample_id_col)) {
  cand <- c(
    "sample_id",
    "sample-id",
    "sampleid",
    "SampleID",
    "#SampleID",
    "id",
    "ID",
    "#OTU ID",
    "featureid"
  )

  hit <- cand[cand %in% colnames(meta)]

  if (!length(hit)) {
    stop(paste(
      "set sample_id_col. cols:",
      paste(colnames(meta), collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  sample_id_col <- hit[1]

  message("Using sample-id column: ", sample_id_col)
}

if (!(region_col %in% colnames(meta))) {
  stop(paste(
    "region_col not found. cols:",
    paste(colnames(meta), collapse = ", ")
  ))
}

meta <- data.frame(
  sample_id = trimws(as.character(meta[[sample_id_col]])),
  region = trimws(as.character(meta[[region_col]])),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

colnames(feat) <- trimws(colnames(feat))

common <- intersect(colnames(feat), meta$sample_id)

if (!length(common)) {
  stop("no overlapping sample ids")
}

cat(sprintf(
  "Samples table=%d metadata=%d overlap=%d\n",
  ncol(feat),
  nrow(meta),
  length(common)
))

feat <- feat[, common, drop = FALSE]
meta <- meta[match(common, meta$sample_id), ]

counts <- t(feat)
counts <- counts[rowSums(counts) > 0, , drop = FALSE]

meta <- meta[match(rownames(counts), meta$sample_id), ]

dim(counts)
head(meta)
```

# 5. Subsample per region

```{r subsample-per-region}
## ---- subsample per region (feasibility + lighter pseudoreplication) ----

set.seed(seed)

keep <- unlist(
  lapply(split(seq_len(nrow(counts)), meta$region), function(ix) {
    if (length(ix) > max_per_region) {
      sample(ix, max_per_region)
    } else {
      ix
    }
  })
)

counts <- counts[keep, , drop = FALSE]
meta <- meta[keep, ]

reg <- factor(meta$region)

cat("Samples per region (after cap):\n")
print(table(reg))
```

# 6. Rarefaction and Jaccard similarity

```{r rarefy-jaccard}
## ---- rarefy + presence + Jaccard SIMILARITY matrix ----

if (do_rarefy) {
  depth <- rowSums(counts)

  target <- if (is.na(min_depth)) {
    min(depth)
  } else {
    as.integer(min_depth)
  }

  low <- depth < target

  if (any(low)) {
    counts <- counts[!low, , drop = FALSE]
    reg <- droplevels(reg[!low])
  }

  counts <- rrarefy(counts, sample = target)

  cat(sprintf("rarefied to %d\n", target))
}

relab <- sweep(counts, 1, rowSums(counts), "/")

pa <- (relab >= detect_thr) * 1L
pa <- pa[, colSums(pa) > 0, drop = FALSE]

M <- 1 - as.matrix(
  vegdist(pa, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)
)

N <- nrow(M)
regv <- as.integer(reg)
levs <- levels(reg)

cat("Final samples per region:\n")
print(table(reg))

dim(M)
```

# 7. Per-region intra/inter tests

```{r intra-inter-tests}
## ---- per-region intra/inter + tests ----

res <- data.frame()
vio <- list()

for (k in seq_along(levs)) {
  inR <- which(regv == k)
  outR <- which(regv != k)

  intra <- pair_vals(M, inR, outR, "intra")
  inter <- pair_vals(M, inR, outR, "inter")

  w <- suppressWarnings(
    wilcox.test(
      intra,
      inter,
      alternative = "greater"
    )
  )

  res <- rbind(
    res,
    data.frame(
      region = levs[k],
      n_in = length(inR),
      n_intra = length(intra),
      n_inter = length(inter),
      med_intra = median(intra),
      med_inter = median(inter),
      excess = median(intra) - median(inter),
      wilcox_p = w$p.value
    )
  )

  vio[[levs[k]]] <- list(
    intra = intra,
    inter = inter
  )
}

res$wilcox_padj <- p.adjust(res$wilcox_p, "BH")

res
```

# 8. Label-permutation P-values

```{r label-permutation}
## ---- label-permutation p ----

obs_diff <- sapply(seq_along(levs), function(k) {
  inR <- which(regv == k)
  outR <- which(regv != k)

  mean(pair_vals(M, inR, outR, "intra")) -
    mean(pair_vals(M, inR, outR, "inter"))
})

null_diff <- matrix(NA, n_perm, length(levs))

set.seed(seed)

for (p in seq_len(n_perm)) {
  pr <- sample(regv)

  null_diff[p, ] <- sapply(seq_along(levs), function(k) {
    inR <- which(pr == k)
    outR <- which(pr != k)

    if (length(inR) < 3) {
      return(NA)
    }

    mean(pair_vals(M, inR, outR, "intra")) -
      mean(pair_vals(M, inR, outR, "inter"))
  })
}

res$perm_p <- sapply(seq_along(levs), function(k) {
  (1 + sum(null_diff[, k] >= obs_diff[k], na.rm = TRUE)) /
    (sum(!is.na(null_diff[, k])) + 1)
})

write.csv(
  res,
  file.path(out_dir, "region_sharing_stats.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

res
```

# 9. Region-level intra vs inter violin plot

```{r region-sharing-violin, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
## ---- base-R dodged violin plot ----

R <- length(levs)

ymax <- max(
  sapply(vio, function(z) {
    max(c(z$intra, z$inter), na.rm = TRUE)
  })
)

draw_region_sharing_violin <- function() {
  par(mar = c(4, 4, 4, 1))

  plot(
    NA,
    xlim = c(0.5, R + 0.5),
    ylim = c(0, ymax * 1.18),
    xaxt = "n",
    xlab = "Region",
    ylab = "ASV sharing rate (Jaccard)",
    main = "Region-level: intra vs inter sharing"
  )

  mtext(
    "EXPLORATORY - confounded by city differences; n inflated by sample-pair pseudoreplication",
    side = 3,
    line = 0.2,
    cex = 0.65,
    col = "grey40"
  )

  axis(
    1,
    at = seq_len(R),
    labels = levs
  )

  for (k in seq_len(R)) {
    violin_at(
      vio[[k]]$inter,
      k - 0.2,
      0.17,
      "grey85"
    )

    violin_at(
      vio[[k]]$intra,
      k + 0.2,
      0.17,
      "#f4a6a6"
    )

    yb <- ymax * 1.05

    segments(
      k - 0.2,
      yb,
      k + 0.2,
      yb,
      lwd = 0.8
    )

    text(
      k,
      yb + ymax * 0.03,
      sprintf(
        "%s | perm p=%.3g",
        stars(res$wilcox_padj[k]),
        res$perm_p[k]
      ),
      cex = 0.7
    )
  }

  legend(
    "topleft",
    legend = c("inter", "intra"),
    fill = c("grey85", "#f4a6a6"),
    bty = "n",
    cex = 0.8
  )
}

# PDF 저장
pdf(
  file.path(out_dir, "region_sharing_violin.pdf"),
  width = 2 + 1.4 * R,
  height = 5
)
draw_region_sharing_violin()
dev.off()

# SVG 저장
svglite::svglite(
  file.path(out_dir, "region_sharing_violin.svg"),
  width = 2 + 1.4 * R,
  height = 5
)
draw_region_sharing_violin()
dev.off()

# R Markdown 화면 출력
draw_region_sharing_violin()
```

# 10. Final report

```{r final-report}
## ---- report ----

cat("\n===== REGION-LEVEL intra vs inter SHARING =====\n")

print(
  res[, c(
    "region",
    "n_in",
    "med_intra",
    "med_inter",
    "excess",
    "wilcox_padj",
    "perm_p"
  )],
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nReading guide:\n")
cat(" - Wilcoxon **** is expected here from sample-pair pseudoreplication; not strong evidence.\n")
cat(" - perm p tests only whether regions are distinct populations at all (cities differ),\n")
cat("   NOT contact-driven sharing. A small perm p just confirms the 3 cities are different.\n")
cat(" - The aggregation-correct sharing analog remains the gu-level null (urban_sharing.R).\n")

cat("\nWritten:\n")
cat(" - results/region_sharing_violin.pdf\n")
cat(" - results/region_sharing_violin.svg\n")
cat(" - results/region_sharing_stats.csv\n")
```
